children.title: Our story
children.intro: MI TRENDS started as a small print run for friends who wanted graphics no one else was wearing. It grew into a full wardrobe.
children.content:
Where we started

We design every graphic, fit and colourway in-house, then run small batches so drops stay original instead of everywhere at once.

No two seasons repeat a print. If a design sells out, it stays retired — that's the point of a drop, not a restock.

How we make it

Heavyweight cotton, proper stitching and washes that hold their shape after the twentieth wear are non-negotiable, even on our lowest-priced pieces.

We work with small manufacturing partners across India and keep runs tight, which also means less leftover stock going to waste.

What's next

More drops, better fits, and eventually stores you can walk into. Join the newsletter at the bottom of the page and you'll hear about all of it first.

children.title: Careers
children.intro: We're a small, fast-moving team based in India. We hire for craft over titles.
children.content:
Open roles

Graphic Designer — Streetwear prints

Customer Experience Associate

Retail Operations Lead (upcoming stores)

We update this list as roles open, so check back or send a general application anytime.

How to apply

Email your resume and portfolio (if relevant) to careers@mitrends.in with the role in the subject line. We reply to every genuine application within two weeks.

children.title: Press
children.intro: For interviews, product seeding, or brand assets, reach our press desk directly.
children.content:
Media contact

Email press@mitrends.in with your publication, deadline and what you need. We usually respond within 2 business days.

Brand assets

Logo files, product photography and founder bios are available on request — just mention it in your email and we'll send a press kit.

children.title: Gift cards
children.intro: Digital gift cards are launching soon, redeemable on any style, any size, any drop.
children.content:
How they'll work

Buy a gift card in any amount, delivered by email instantly. The recipient applies the code at checkout — no expiry, no fine print.

children.title: Stores
children.intro: MI TRENDS is currently a direct-to-you online store while we plan our first physical space.
children.content:
First store

We're scouting locations in major Indian cities. Tell us where you'd like to see us first using the form below and we'll factor it into the plan.

children.title: Shipping
children.intro: Here's exactly what to expect after you place an order.
children.content:
Delivery timelines

Metro cities: 3-5 business days.

Rest of India: 5-7 business days.

Remote pin codes may take a little longer — we'll flag this at checkout if it applies to you.

Shipping charges

Free shipping on orders of ₹999 and above.

A flat ₹79 fee applies on smaller orders.

Cash on delivery orders carry an additional ₹49 handling fee.

Tracking your order

Once your order ships, you'll get an SMS and email with tracking details. You can also check status anytime on our Track order page.

Delays

Festive periods, extreme weather or courier disruptions can occasionally push delivery out by a couple of days. We'll always keep you posted if that happens.

children.title: Returns
children.intro: 30 days, no drama — here's how returns and exchanges work.
children.content:
Return window

You have 30 days from the delivery date to return any unworn, unwashed item with its tags still attached.

How to return

Head to Track order, enter your order ID, and choose "Start a return". We'll arrange a free pickup from your address.

Refunds

Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days of us receiving the item back, to your original payment method. Cash on delivery orders are refunded to your bank account or UPI ID.

Exchanges

Need a different size or colour instead? Choose exchange rather than refund during the return request, subject to stock availability.

What can't be returned

Innerwear, accessories marked final sale, and any item without its original tags can't be accepted back for hygiene and quality reasons.

children.content:
Acceptance of terms

Orders & pricing

Payments

We accept UPI, major debit/credit cards, net banking and cash on delivery. Payments are processed through encrypted, PCI-compliant partners.

Shipping & returns

Delivery timelines and our return policy are detailed on the Shipping and Returns pages, which form part of these terms.

Intellectual property

All designs, graphics and site content belong to MI TRENDS and may not be reproduced without written permission.

Limitation of liability

MI TRENDS is not liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from use of the site, to the extent permitted by Indian law.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India, with courts in the jurisdiction of our registered office having exclusive authority.

Questions

Write to legal@mitrends.in for anything not covered here.

children.title: Privacy policy
children.intro: What we collect, why we collect it, and how it's kept safe.
children.content:
Information we collect

Your name, contact details and delivery address when you check out, plus basic browsing behaviour to improve the site.

How we use it

Solely to process orders, provide support, and — only if you opt in — send you updates about new drops.

Cookies

We use cookies to remember your bag and preferences during a session. You can disable them in your browser, though parts of the site may work less smoothly.

Sharing with third parties

We only share the minimum required data with payment processors and courier partners needed to fulfil your order. We never sell your data.

Data security

Payment details are encrypted end-to-end and we never store your UPI information on our servers.

Your rights

You can request a copy of your data, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it by writing to privacy@mitrends.in.

children.title: Accessibility
children.intro: We're working to make MI TRENDS usable for every visitor, regardless of ability.
children.content:
Our commitment

We aim to meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines across the site, and we review new features against them before launch.

What we've built in

Keyboard-navigable menus and carousels, descriptive alt text on product imagery, visible focus states, and colour contrast that holds up in daylight and dark mode alike.

Still working on it

Accessibility is ongoing work, not a one-time checklist. If something doesn't work well with your screen reader, keyboard or browser settings, we want to know.

Tell us

Email accessibility@mitrends.in with the page and issue — we treat these reports as priority fixes.

children.title: FAQs
children.intro: Everything most people ask before or after ordering.
children.content:
Orders & payments

Which payment methods do you accept?

UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, and cash on delivery across India.

Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?

Yes, within 2 hours of placing it — write to us with your order ID. After that, packing has usually already started.

I didn't get an order confirmation. What do I do?

Check your spam or promotions folder first. Still nothing after 30 minutes? Contact us with your registered mobile number and we'll resend it.

Shipping

How long does delivery take?

4-7 business days for most pin codes; metro cities are usually on the faster end.

Is shipping free?

Free on orders above ₹999. Below that, a flat ₹79 fee applies, plus ₹49 for cash on delivery.

Do you ship outside India?

Not yet — we're focused on serving India well before we expand.

Returns & exchanges

What's your return window?

30 days from delivery, for unworn items with tags intact.

How do I start a return?

Go to Track order, enter your order ID, and choose "Start a return" — or just contact support.

When will I get my refund?

Within 5-7 business days of us receiving the returned item.

Sizing

How do I pick the right size?

Check our Size guide and compare the measurements with a similar piece you already own.

What if the size doesn't fit?

Exchange it for a different size, free of cost, within the return window.
